Compiled Section 6.01(b) clauses (4) through (11) and (20) - all as PERMISSION exceptions ('carve-outs') to the general Indebtedness/Disqualified Stock/Preferred Stock incurrence prohibition in Section 6.01(a), which binds the Borrowers and Restricted Subsidiaries (collectively 'Restricted Parties').

Clauses (12) through (19) inclusive are explicitly out of scope for this shard (owned by other shards per the source-omission notice) and were not compiled; no inventory item from that gap was claimed.

Section 6.01(b)(28) (Unsecured Capitalized Leases, referenced for avoidance of doubt in clause (4)(a)) and Section 6.01(b)(13) (Refinancing Indebtedness, which shares the clause (4) aggregate cap) are outside this submission's scope; both are preserved as explicit dependsOn cross-references on rule r1 rather than guessed or dropped.

Rule r1 (clause (4)(a)) is the only rule in this batch with an explicit dollar/formula cap; all other rules in this batch (clauses (4)(b)-(c), (5)-(11), (20)) are genuinely uncapped by dollar amount in the source text and are represented as UNLIMITED_CAPACITY, gated only by the qualitative conditions actually stated (e.g., ordinary course of business, 30-day reimbursement, subordination provisos) rather than an invented dollar ceiling.

Clauses (7), (8) and (9) each contain a 'deemed incurrence/issuance' anti-abuse trigger tied to subsequent transfers of Capital Stock or status changes; these are modeled as exceptions narrowing the permission's scope rather than as freestanding baskets, since they operate as limitations on when the exception continues to apply.

All 70 items in the frozen semantic inventory for this provision were consumed (mapped into a rule's own inventoryItemIds, a condition, an exception, or a capacityExpression subnode); none required disposition as omitted, since each corresponded to identifiable operative text within clauses (4)-(11) and (20).
